messages:
lex_cs: Hey team - kicking off AuroraSys onboarding (pilot -> prod ~3w). Need owners for SSO, export schema, perf, and an exec-ready cost summary.

mira_impl: I can own integration (SSO + export). Quick Q: do they want SAML only or SCIM for provisioning?

zhou_eng: SAML first is fine. I'll own staging perf and the latency/load tests. Need estimated concurrent sessions and batch sizes.

ayla_pm: From product: success = (1) SSO validated, (2) daily export to Snowflake with agreed schema, (3) median chat latency <250ms and embedding p95 <2s, (4) cost-per-10k-tokens <= target after baseline. Exec demo must show cost delta vs current provider.

ravi_renewals: Renewal note: finance will flag any opaque token billing. I'll prepare a one-pager showing unit economics and recommended model configs to hit cost goals.

lex_cs: Proposed owners: Lex = CS lead, Mira = Impl lead, Zhou = Eng perf, Ayla = PM liaison, Ravi = Renewal lead. OK?

mira_impl: OK. I'll draft the data contract + sample CSV schema and request IdP metadata and sample rows from AuroraSys.

zhou_eng: Technical flag: AuroraSys uses long document prompts (~6k-9k tokens) for some flows. Recommend an A/B eval (full precision vs quantized) during Week 1. Tagging as model-eval.

ayla_pm: I'll collect traffic profile and coordinate anonymized prompt samples. They asked for a sanitization script  we should offer one.

sync-bot: Meeting scheduled: "AuroraSys Internal Onboard Prep" Tue 11am PT 2D calendar invite sent.

lex_cs: Action items for today: 1) Mira - data contract + IdP checklist (EOD). 2) Zhou - staging perf plan + A/B template. 3) Ayla - traffic profile + anonymization plan. 4) Ravi - renewal one-pager draft. I'll request prompt set and IdP metadata from customer.

mira_impl: I'll add retention & encryption (TLS + AES-256) to the checklist.

zhou_eng: I'll include memory config notes if context >8k tokens. Will sync with Optimize team if needed.

lex_cs: Great. Thanks team 1F389 we'll run the internal sync before the customer kickoff."
